speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma of the head of the pancreas. The imaging confirms a 2.5 cm mass in the pancreatic head causing malignant biliary obstruction, which explains your jaundice, pale stools, and dark urine. Given the confirmed mass, further staging with a Chest CT is indicated before we discuss definitive treatment options.
